summary_1line: Bhishma extols Krishna/Vasudeva as the supreme cosmic being and urges Duryodhana to make peace with the Pandavas under his protection.

image_candidates.scene_text: The cosmic form of Vishnu lies upon the primordial waters in yogic sleep while creation—fire, wind, gods, and worlds—emerges from his body.
Bhishma speaks gravely to Duryodhana in the war camp, urging him to make peace with the Pandavas under Krishna’s divine protection.
Vishnu slays the fierce demon Madhu who arose from the secretions of his ear and threatened Brahman.
